# runpod_cluster_pods (Data Source)

The member pods of one cluster, with their runtime state and cluster ranks. Member pods are excluded from the account-wide runpod_pods listing unless it sets include_cluster_pods.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_cluster_pods" "training" {
  cluster_id = "cluster_abc123"
}

output "overlay_addresses_by_rank" {
  description = "Each member pod's address on the cluster's private network, keyed by node rank."
  value = {
    for p in data.runpod_cluster_pods.training.pods : p.cluster_rank => p.cluster_ip
    if p.cluster_rank != null
  }
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster whose pods to list.

### Read-Only

- `pods` (Attributes List) One entry per member pod. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pods))

<a id="nestedatt--pods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pods`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud tier: SECURE or COMMUNITY.
- `cluster_ip` (String) The pod's address on the cluster's private overlay network; null until assigned.
- `cluster_rank` (Number) Node rank (NODE_RANK) within the cluster; rank 0 is the primary. Null until assigned.
- `cluster_role` (String) SLURM or RAY role, e.g. SLURM_CONTROLLER. Null for TRAINING and APPLICATION clusters, which assign no roles.
- `cost` (Number) Current cost in USD per hour; 0 when the pod is stopped.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `data_center_id` (String) Data center the pod runs in.
- `disk` (Number) Container disk in GB (ephemeral).
- `gpu_count` (Number) Number of GPUs attached to the pod.
- `gpu_type_id` (String) GPU type identifier; null for a pod with no GPU.
- `id` (String) Pod identifier.
- `image` (String) Docker image reference.
- `name` (String) Pod display name.
- `status` (String) Pod lifecycle status, e.g. RUNNING, PROVISIONING.
